text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to prohibit standing at all times on the north side of Corby Avenue, between Caledonia Road and a point 15 metres east of Caledonia Road. This parking regulation amendment was at the request of the local Councillor, on behalf of area residents.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the north side of Corby Avenue, between Caledonia Road and a point 15 metres east of Caledonia Road.
